name: Mirabito Energy Products
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public mirabito.com pages (Automatic Payment Information, Heating Oil and Propane Pricing & Payments, 'Can I make payments and see my account online?' FAQ, Price Agreement document guide); no sign-in, no enrollment, no DocuSign forms opened or submitted. The MyAccount Portal (myaccount.mirabito.com, 'ENROLL / SIGN IN', 'Login or Create Portal') renders client-side, so the sign-in identifier is not known and the family default is kept; enrolling ('Sign Up') needs the Mirabito account number from the delivery invoice. In the portal customers make payments, view the account and set up recurring credit card or EFT/ACH payments. Separate DocuSign forms exist for Budget Autopay (Price Protection contracts: 11 drafts on the 10th, September through July, paperwork by September 2 for the first draft, changes by June 20; any balance left after June 10 is drafted in full on July 10), Credit Card Autopay and EFT Authorization (non-budget). The family AutoPay timing is kept for portal AutoPay because the portal's draft date is not published. Budget plans: Market Rate Budget Plan (no enrollment fee, 20 cents per gallon discount, credits roll over) and Budget Cap Plan; Prepay Fixed and Prepay Cap plans. HEAP vouchers are accepted (fax 607-584-5133). Statements show the amount to pay in the 'Total Payment Due' box; delivery tickets and delivery invoices are not bills. Fees, late charges and account closing are not published on the pages used. Review 2026-10-10: the price agreement guide moved to /blog/priceagreement-documentguide/ (old URL redirects to the home page); the unsupported 'Mirabito app' mention was dropped and the portal help now follows the MyAccount how-to post.

autopay.note: Recurring payments can be charged to a credit card or drawn from a checking account (EFT/ACH). Budget customers on a Price Protection contract use the Budget Autopay form instead; those drafts run on the 10th of each month.

help.title: Paying online
paragraphs: Use the Mirabito MyAccount Portal to pay bills, order fuel, request service, accept price protection agreements and check your Mirabito Rewards.

To set up online access, choose Sign Up, complete the registration form, accept the terms and link your Mirabito account with your account number, which is printed on your delivery invoice. Call 800-934-9480 if you cannot find it.
steps: Sign in, or choose Sign Up and link your account number.
Choose to make a payment and pick a card or checking account.

help.title: Automatic payment
paragraphs: In the MyAccount Portal you can set up recurring payments by credit card or by EFT/ACH from your checking account. Separate secure forms are available for credit card autopay and for EFT on deliveries that are not part of a price protection contract.

Budget customers on a Price Protection contract use the Budget Autopay form: 11 payments are drafted on the 10th of each month from September through July (the next business day if the 10th is a weekend or holiday). Any balance remaining after the June payment is drafted in full in July. To change or cancel, contact the office by June 20. You still get a monthly budget statement and an email before each transfer.

help.title: Budget and prepay plans
paragraphs: Budget plans divide your yearly fuel cost into equal monthly payments. The Market Rate Budget Plan has no enrollment fee, takes 20 cents off each gallon and bills at the price on the delivery day; credits roll over to the next year. The Budget Cap Plan guarantees your price per gallon never goes above an agreed cap, and you get the lower market price when it drops.

Prepay plans are paid up front: the Prepay Fixed Plan locks in a price for your estimated gallons and the Prepay Cap Plan sets a maximum yearly price. Extra gallons are billed at the market rate. Mirabito also accepts HEAP; call a Mirabito Care Center specialist at 800-934-9480 for your account number before applying.

help.title: Reading your statement
paragraphs: Mirabito sends three kinds of documents. The delivery ticket and the delivery invoice are for your records and are not bills. Your statement is the bill: pay the amount in the box labelled Total Payment Due. On a budget statement, the New Balance line is a running total of credits and debits, not what you owe today.

extra.intent: Using the Mirabito website's help pages, find on which day of the month Budget Autopay payments are drafted. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Budget Autopay drafts on the 10th of each month.
